subject: Order OS-3819815: plush received torn, refund requested
message:
Dear customer service,

On January 1 I placed order OS-3819815 for the Claude plush in terracotta. The order was delivered on January 5. When I took the plush out of the box I found that it was torn, so this is more than a loose thread. The plush has remained in the condition in which it arrived. One photograph is attached.

I expect a refund for this order. I do not want a replacement, and I do not regard a repair on my part as acceptable. An item sold as new should arrive intact, and this one did not. If you require the plush to be sent back, I expect you to supply the label and the instructions.

Please confirm the refund in writing by January 16. If I have had no reply by that date, I will write again and quote this message.

Veronica Maldonado
